bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised course project, wrote Python functions to parse provided review records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, used TF-IDF features and a logistic-regression text classifier in scikit-learn for product reviews; evaluated a fixed held-out split using macro F-score and example errors.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to supervised research, wrote Python functions to parse provided news summary records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Cleaned supplied publication metadata tables using provided steps in pandas, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
